title: Integral constant module pushforwards are filtered colimits of finite pushforwards
statement: For integral nu : Y -> X with X Noetherian, finite commutative Lambda and finite Lambda-module M, there are a filtered category I small in universe u, finite X-schemes f_i : Z_i -> X, a diagram D of module sheaves with isomorphisms D_i = f_i,* M_{Z_i}, and a colimit cocone from D to nu_* M_Y [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

source.place: Tag 09Z6 proof of (1), finite approximation paragraph, using Tags 09YZ and 09Z1, transferred to (3)

proof.text: Choose a finite approximation F of nu using Scheme.Hom.nonempty_finiteApproximation_of_isIntegralHom (the version of the existing approximation theorem without finite presentation, which is not needed here). Noetherian X is compact and quasi-separated. The index F.I is small and cofiltered; F.p gives finite structure maps; F.D has affine transitions, F.pi is a limit cone and F.pi_p identifies its structure map with nu.

source.place: Tag 09Z1, degree-zero transition maps and continuity; Tag 09Z6, finite approximation paragraph, lines 12999-13008

proof.text: Reverse F.I. Define D by constantModulePushforwardDiagram and c by constantModulePushforwardCocone. The identity and composition laws and cocone naturality follow from the two parts of the functoriality theorem. The stage objects are definitionally the finite constant-module pushforwards, so take Iso.refl at every stage.

source.place: Tag 09Z1, degree-zero transition maps and continuity; Tag 09Z6, finite approximation paragraph, lines 12999-13008

proof.text: All stage structure maps are finite and hence affine and qcqs; nu is integral and hence affine and qcqs. Apply isColimit_constantModulePushforwardCocone to F.isLimit. Return F.I^op, the stages F.D.obj, F.p, D, the identity stage isomorphisms, and c.iota. Cocone.mk with these legs is definitionally c, so this closes exactly the original existential conclusion.

theorem exists_filtered_colimit_finite_lowerStar_constant
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (ν : Y ⟶ X) [IsIntegralHom ν]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) [Finite M] :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : SmallCategory I) (_ : IsFiltered I)
      (Z : I → Scheme.{u}) (f : ∀ i : I, Z i ⟶ X), (∀ i : I, IsFinite (f i)) ∧
      ∃ (D : I ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)),
        (∀ i : I, Nonempty (D.obj i ≅ (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (f i)).obj
          ((constantSheaf (Z i).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M))) ∧
        ∃ (η : D ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj
          ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) ν).obj
            ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M))),
          Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk _ η))
